description: This file declares the 'channel_estimate' class used for channel estimation results in a wireless communication system, including data structures, getters, setters, and internal management of channel state information.

classes.name: channel_estimate
classes.description: Class representing channel estimation results, including statistical data, channel state information, and resource element estimates.

methods.name: get_noise_variance
methods.description: Returns the estimated noise variance for a specified receive port.

methods.name: get_noise_variance_dB
methods.description: Returns the noise variance in dB scale for a specified receive port.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Returns the RSRP for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_rsrp_all_ports
methods.description: Returns RSRP estimates for all receive ports for a given transmit layer.

methods.name: get_rsrp_dB
methods.description: Returns the RSRP in dB scale for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_epre
methods.description: Returns the average energy per resource element (EPRE) for a given receive port.

methods.name: get_epre_dB
methods.description: Returns the EPRE in dB scale for a given receive port.

methods.name: get_snr
methods.description: Returns the SNR for a specific receive port.

methods.name: get_layer_average_snr
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average SNR across all receive ports for a given transmit layer.

methods.name: get_snr_dB
methods.description: Returns the SNR in dB scale for a specific receive port.

methods.name: get_time_alignment
methods.description: Returns the time alignment in PHY units between a receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Returns the carrier frequency offset in Hz for a given receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_path_ch_estimate
methods.description: Provides a modifiable view of channel estimates for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_path_ch_estimate (const)
methods.description: Provides a read-only view of channel estimates for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate
methods.description: Provides a modifiable view of channel estimates for a specific OFDM symbol, receive port, and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate (const)
methods.description: Provides a read-only view of channel estimates for a specific OFDM symbol, receive port, and transmit layer.

methods.name: get_channel_state_information
methods.description: Fills a channel_state_information object with current CSI parameters.

methods.name: set_noise_variance
methods.description: Sets the noise variance estimate for a specific receive port.

methods.name: set_rsrp
methods.description: Sets the RSRP estimate for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: set_epre
methods.description: Sets the EPRE estimate for a specific receive port.

methods.name: set_snr
methods.description: Sets the SNR estimate for a specific receive port.

methods.name: set_time_alignment
methods.description: Sets the time alignment estimate between a receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: set_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Sets the carrier frequency offset estimate in Hz for a specific receive port and transmit layer.

methods.name: set_ch_estimate
methods.description: Sets the channel estimate for a specific resource element, receive port, and transmit layer.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes internal buffers based on provided dimensions.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns current channel estimate dimensions.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns maximum supported channel estimate dimensions.
